summary: Replace the copied Stem-I base forms with the Stem-II forms
rationale: This is explicitly Stem II, and its example kə-mšaqaṣno has the Stem-II mšaq- formation. The displayed šqəṣle/šoqəṣ instead exactly repeats the Stem-I forms of šqṣ 1. The proposed pair follows the Stem-II pattern also displayed by šqṭ.II mšaqaṭle/mšaqəṭ.
